about_the_game:
Speak of the Devil! Devil’s Sacrifice is a brand new DLC for Sker Ritual!

Mint Sauce is baack and they’ve got a bone to pick with ewe.



The Devil’s Sacrifice DLC unlocks a new mask and exclusive items to avenge your sacrifice and wool the world.

Sker Island can’t pull the wool over your eyes with the Lamb mask. Mint Sauce refuses to be put out to pasture but is fond of their Sker Pasture background. Enemies won’t forget their devilish sacrifice with the Lamb Scream echoing in the fields around them and don’t be sheepish with the Demon Lamb Emblem Mint Sauce is counting on ewe.



This pack includes 4 new items:

The Lamb Mask


An Exclusive Premium Mask of the demonic sacrificial Lamb

Sker Pasture


An Exclusive Premium Animated Menu Background of the Sker Pasture

Lamb Scream


An Exclusive In-Game Voice Line to ensure ewe are herd

Demon Lamb Emblem


An Exclusive Demon Lamb Emblem Player Icon, because you’re not sheepish
